description: Pinned real-world OSS agent repos for the doctor corpus test (roadmap Stage 2 · Phase 0 · deliverable 5). The bar is CRASH-FREE: the doctor must scan every file without raising (a parse/decode failure is a loud SAKRIT000 finding, never an escaped exception). Finding density is recorded to tune the noise floor before launch. Repos are pinned at a fixed SHA for reproducibility; refresh deliberately, never silently.

repos.note: OpenAI Agents SDK — a directly-adapted framework
LangGraph — a directly-adapted framework; large, diverse Python (parser stress)
CrewAI — a framework we do not adapt (non-ship verdict); scanned for robustness
Pydantic AI — an agent framework with real HTTP/provider calls
